subject: tutorial on how to use a pre-compiled model - rstan

messages.author: 7a97c986864bf6d6
messages.subject: tutorial on how to use a pre-compiled model - rstan
parts:
Hello Community,

I have read kind of answers on how to compile a model and keep using that without compiling it every time. However, nothing really crystal clear to me.

Is there any kind of step-by-step instruction on how simply use an already compiled model in rstan (linux)?

Thanks a lot!
Stefano

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: tutorial on how to use a pre-compiled model - rstan
parts:
On Monday, October 24, 2016 at 2:37:04 AM UTC-4, Stefano wrote:
I have read kind of answers on how to compile a model and keep using that without compiling it every time. However, nothing really crystal clear to me.

Is there any kind of step-by-step instruction on how simply use an already compiled model in rstan (linux)?

Step 1: Execute rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
Step 2: Make sure your Stan program ends in a blank line
